entities.name: Leo I of Cava
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leo I of Cava was an Italian abbot and the second abbot of the Abbey of La Trinità della Cava in Cava de' Tirreni. He is venerated as a saint in the Roman Catholic Church.
